reference_caveats.terminal_chemistry: Conditional free NH3+/COO- termini and five deprotonated acidic side chains; experimental terminal specification unresolved.
reference_caveats.vacuum_dianion: Post-added fixed-FF ALPB does not polarize or stabilize the vacuum SCF density self-consistently; finite-basis convergence does not prove electron binding or a stable ground state.
reference_caveats.frozen_f: Physical La multiplicity1/Dy6; effective singlets with La ECP46/Dy ECP55, spin-free frozen-f representation without SOC.
reference_caveats.geometry: One fixed 7CCO La-proposed before/after deformation; both endpoints nonstationary, no geometry repair or optimization.
reference_caveats.reference_scope: Whole vacuum PBE0 replaces all internal electronic/MM terms; only unchanged fixed-FF ALPB is added. No CPCM or external point charges.
reference_caveats.force_qualification: Native analytic-gradient admission only; no numerical derivative test or statistical force-accuracy threshold in this four-cell proposal.
reference_caveats.interpretation: Independent conditional force/work diagnostic, not an affinity prediction, an exact MACE training-functional replay, or a unique MM-parameter attribution.
